pr.title: fix data race in GetWebAssets

raw_findings.body: After the first goroutine populates entryPointAssetsCache, each subsequently unblocked goroutine still executes readWebAssetsFromFile/readWebAssetsFromCDN and re-reads the manifest instead of returning the freshly cached value, performing redundant file/CDN I/O for every queued caller.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Concurrent callers each perform expensive manifest loading that the cache was intended to avoid.
raw_findings.impact: After the first goroutine populates entryPointAssetsCache, each subsequently unblocked goroutine still executes readWebAssetsFromFile/readWebAssetsFromCDN and re-reads the manifest instead of returning the freshly cached value, performing redundant file/CDN I/O for every queued caller.
raw_findings.root_cause: The rewrite converted the single unlocked check into an RLock check plus a write lock but did not add the second cache check inside the write-locked critical section.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Implement proper double-checked locking: after acquiring the write lock, re-read entryPointAssetsCache and, if it is non-nil and cfg.Env != setting.Dev, return it immediately before doing any file/CDN read.
raw_findings.title: Missing re-check after acquiring write lock causes redundant asset reads
raw_findings.trigger: Multiple goroutines call GetWebAssets concurrently at startup (non-Dev) while the cache is still nil; they all pass the RLock check with ret==nil and then queue on the write lock.

finding.title: Missing re-check after acquiring write lock causes redundant asset reads
finding.trigger: Multiple goroutines call GetWebAssets concurrently at startup (non-Dev) while the cache is still nil; they all pass the RLock check with ret==nil and then queue on the write lock.
finding.verifier_reason: The patch at lines 41-49 shows RLock check followed by Lock acquisition without re-checking entryPointAssetsCache inside the write-locked section. Multiple goroutines passing the RLock check with ret==nil will queue on Lock and each will execute readWebAssetsFromFile/readWebAssetsFromCDN even after the first populates the cache. The cited lines 48-49 exist verbatim in the patch, the trigger is realistic for concurrent startup, and redundant I/O is a concrete performance impact.
